query_ground_truth.workflow_task: As a project manager reorganizing our team's workflow, I need to set up a new project tracking column in our main Trello board for the upcoming sprint. Additionally, a key stakeholder asked for an update on a specific discussion in our team Slack channel, so I need to find that exact message and drop a thumbs-up emoji reaction on it to acknowledge their point before our daily standup meeting.
query_ground_truth.query: create a new list named Sprint Backlog on our main project tracking Trello board
query_ground_truth.rationale: Creates the requested new list/column on the specified Trello board.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if avoiding duplicate titles or needing current order)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch existing lists using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD (normalize titles; capture list ids and current positions).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm final list title(s), desired placement (top/bottom/numeric), and whether any existing lists should be kept, renamed, or archived before using TRELLO_ADD_LISTS.
[Optional (if removing unwanted/default lists)] [Step]: Archive selected existing lists using TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_CLOSED_BY_ID_LIST (repeat per list id).
[Required] [Step]: Create list(s) using TRELLO_ADD_LISTS (persist each returned list id immediately; if adding multiple to the same top position, create in reverse intended order).
[Optional (if ordering must be deterministic after create)] [Next Step]: Reorder using TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_POS_BY_ID_LIST (use persisted list ids; set numeric positions for stable order).
[Optional (if names must change after create)] [Next Step]: Rename using TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_NAME_BY_ID_LIST (pass the new title via the value field).

[Fallback (if create fails due to invalid board reference or permissions)] [Fallback]: Re-validate board using TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_BY_ID_BOARD (use canonical id from response), then retry TRELLO_ADD_LISTS and verify via TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD.
known_pitfalls: [TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD] Response shape can be a bare array or wrapped (for example under data.lists); handle both before iterating/deduping.
[TRELLO_ADD_LISTS] Created list id may appear at data.id or inside nested data wrappers; extract defensively and persist immediately.
[TRELLO_ADD_LISTS] Returned pos is often a large numeric value even when a symbolic pos is requested; treat ordering as non-deterministic without a reorder pass.
[TRELLO_ADD_LISTS] Creating multiple lists with the same placement can yield overlapping/identical numeric pos values; enforce final order with TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_POS_BY_ID_LIST.
[TRELLO_ADD_LISTS] HTTP 400 validation errors (for example invalid board id) can occur when a non-canonical identifier is used; recover via TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_BY_ID_BOARD.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Pattern for bulk-creating lists and robustly extracting created list identifiers
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
items=[{"idBoard":"BOARD_ID","name":"LIST_TITLE","pos":"bottom"}]
out=[]
for it in items:
 r,e=run_composio_tool("TRELLO_ADD_LISTS",it)
 d=(r or {}).get("data",{})
 d=d.get("data",d)
 out.append({"name":it["name"],"list_id":d.get("id"),"pos":d.get("pos"),"error":str(e) if e else None})
```

TRELLO_ADD_LISTS.description: Creates a new list on a specified Trello board, with options to copy an existing list, set its position, initial state (archived/subscribed), and does not modify existing lists or move cards.

pos.description: The position of the new list on the board. Valid values are `top`, `bottom`, or a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5').

name.description: The name for the new list. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters. This is a required parameter.

closed.description: Indicates whether the list should be created as closed (archived). Set to `true` for closed, or `false` for open.

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to which the new list should be added. This is a required parameter.

subscribed.description: Indicates whether the user creating the list should be automatically subscribed to it. Set to `true` to subscribe, or `false` otherwise.

idListSource.description: The ID of an existing list to copy when creating the new list. If provided, the new list will be a copy of this source list.

TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_LISTS_BY_ID_BOARD.description: Retrieves lists from a specified Trello board, with options to filter lists and include card details.

cards.description: Determines which cards should be returned within the lists. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

fields.description: Specifies the fields of the lists to be returned. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: closed, idBoard, name, pos, or subscribed.

filter.description: Filters the lists to be returned based on their status. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board. Valid formats: 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '60d5f2f1c8a8b4002b8f0123') OR 8-character shortLink (e.g., 'TH6F0pTM'). Human-readable board names or URL slugs (e.g., 'my-board', 'tech-jcorp') are NOT valid identifiers. In the URL 'trello.com/b/TH6F0pTM/my-board', 'TH6F0pTM' is the valid shortLink, while 'my-board' is just a slug and cannot be used. To find your board ID or shortLink: use TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER to list your boards, or look at the board URL in your browser.

card_fields.description: Specifies the fields of cards to be returned if the 'cards' parameter is not 'none'. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields include: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, or url.

TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_NAME_BY_ID_LIST.description: Updates the name of an existing Trello list, identified by its ID; this only changes the list's name, not its cards or position.

value.description: New name for the list. Must be between 1 and 16384 characters.

idList.description: ID of the list to rename.

TRELLO_UPDATE_LISTS_CLOSED_BY_ID_LIST.description: Updates whether an existing Trello list is closed (archived); a closed list is hidden from the board...

TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_BY_ID_BOARD.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific Trello board by its ID; this is a read-only action.
